messages:
Mira Patel: Quick sync — HarborBank POC scoping. Need to lock golden dataset definition, scoring rubric, and regression gates by EOD Thu so sales can confirm timeline with customer. Use cases: 1) support summarization 2) transaction triage 3) structured regulatory extraction.
Alex Gomez: Can we get a proposed minimal golden set size and examples format? Also question on Dedicated pricing vs Hosted for the pilot.
Samir Khan: Minimal golden set: 1k per use case (so 3k total) gives stable metrics. Prefer JSONL with fields: id, prompt, reference, metadata(channel, region, priority). Stratify by channel and severity for triage.
Jordan Lee: Proposed quick scoring rubric: summaries -> ROUGE-L; extraction -> F1 on entities; triage -> precision/recall on labels. Add a manual 100-sample spot-check for hallucinations.
Priya Rao: Security heads-up: HarborBank requires VPC + BYOK and signed NDA before test data transfer. They'll expect our answers to their vendor security questionnaire — sec team to respond within 48h. @sec-bot can you confirm?
sec-bot: SECURITY TASK: Received HarborBank questionnaire (SLA, KMS, audit logs, incident response). Assigned to Priya Rao and Jordan Lee. ETA for draft answers: 48 hours.
Alex Gomez: For the eval harness, plan is to run three model variants: rdx-small (baseline), rdx-quant (cost-optimized), rdx-fallback (safety/backup). Regression gate: fail if any key metric drops >5% absolute or hallucination rate increases above 2%.
Samir Khan: Example scoring config to include in the harness (will commit to repo):
```
scoring:
  summary:
    metric: rouge_l
    threshold: 0.60
  extraction:
    metric: f1
    threshold: 0.85
  triage:
    metric: micro_f1
    threshold: 0.80
  hallucination:
    metric: entity_precision
    threshold: 0.98
regression_gate:
  window: last-3-deploys
  max_drop_absolute: 0.05
  max_hallucination_delta: 0.02
```
Jordan Lee: Add routable tags in the golden set for 'sensitive' so we can run separate privacy checks. Also include a tiny on-prem subset (50 records) to validate VPC + BYOK flows.
Priya Rao: On pricing — if they need Dedicated pilot (reserved GPUs) we should propose a short-term monthly commit. Alex, can you draft an offer with delta vs hosted?
Alex Gomez: Will draft pricing today. Early estimate: Hosted pilot + eval harness = credits + support; Dedicated 1-month pilot (4x A10g equiv) adds a monthly minimum. I'll put numbers in the shared worksheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/harbor-poc (internal).
Samir Khan: Timeline suggestion: Week0: NDA + security questionnaire; Week1: gather golden examples; Week2: run harness + baseline; Week3: analyze, fix regressions, demo. Contingency: if security responses take >48h shift by a week.
Mira Patel: That timeline looks good. Two immediate actions: 1) Sales to get sample production prompts from customer (ideally 50 examples each). 2) Eng to create scoring config and create harness job template.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: eval-harborbank-176750 - will run once goldenset uploaded.
Jordan Lee: I'll own harness job + regression automation. Samir will own goldenset schema and sampling. Priya will lead security questionnaire. Alex will own pricing. Mira will coordinate dates with customer.
Alex Gomez: Ping me in DM if customer expects an NDA template change.
Priya Rao: Noted. If anyone gets PHI-like content, flag immediately and we'll escalate to legal.
Mira Patel: Thanks all — I'll update the sheet and send customer the checklist by EOD. :thumbsup:
Samir Khan: I'll start a PR with the scoring config and a small example goldenset (30 samples) for initial run.
Jordan Lee: Plan to schedule the demo for Week3 Friday tentatively.
Mira Patel: Closing loop: need final confirmation by Thu EOD or we shift demo.
